noNamedServer: No named authorization server exists in this realm yet; the default one answers at {endpoint}.
noGrantsInState: No grants in the {state} state in this realm.
noResourceSets: No resource server has registered a resource set in this realm (RFC 9767 section 3.4).
intro: GNAP (RFC 9635) and its resource server connections (RFC 9767), one authorization server per trust realm. A client instance proves a key at the grant endpoint, a resource owner approves in a browser through the one sign-in screen, and the tokens are released at the continuation URI in any of the five RFC 9767 formats.
turnedOff: GNAP is turned off in this realm.
keyProofWarn: A key proof is verified in every mode. An unsigned or wrongly signed request is refused whatever global.mode says, because a token bound to a key nobody proved holding is bound to nothing. What is mode-gated is what happens to a proved key this service has never seen (development makes an application entry for it; product refuses it) and to an unregistered finish URI.
namedServersAt: Each named authorization server is also a GNAP authorization server at {path}.
discoveryOverriddenOn: Its discovery members are overridden or removed on
publishesWhatEnforces: , and what it publishes is what its grant endpoint enforces.
jwtEncrypted: Nested in a JWE: to the resource server's gnapJweKey, or to this authorization server (introspect it)
macaroon: HMAC-SHA256 under a root key per resource server, carried sealed as gnapMacaroonKey on its entry
noApplications: No application in this realm uses GNAP yet.
monitorIntro: What the applications using GNAP have done, counted since {since} in this trust realm. An application is listed when it is declared for GNAP, when it has spoken it, or both — so an entry provisioned and never used shows here as idle.
